title: SKE Crystal VMT Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: VMT Ice flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid combines the nostalgic flavour of the classic dark berry cordial with a refreshing menthol finish, creating a perfect balance between sweet and invigorating. This flavour is an excellent choice for vapers who appreciate the depth of dark berries and the crispness of menthol. This e-liquid is part of the SKE Crystal Nic Salts collection, known for its smooth nicotine delivery and balanced throat hit. The 50VG/50PG ratio makes it compatible with a wide range of mouth-to-lung devices, ensuring a consistent and enjoyable vaping experience. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
